verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing line saying corporate cards come with "full spending control, flexible limits". That is a thin, first-party mention of transaction-type limits scoped to cards, not to accounts or programs. Approval flows and IP allowlists are adjacent controls and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: per-account and per-program limit configuration, velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, account freeze capability, documented reinstatement paths, and API/docs depth or independent corroboration for any of these.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths

citations.quote: Unlimited physical and virtual cards with full spending control, flexible limits, detailed reports
